notes.collection_first_policy: Finding F6C-R1-04. A profile with no gathering policies takes its first one through the supported path that needs no backend change: GET /api/run-templates publishes the shipped defaults at templates[i].policies.gather[<reference>] (farm/tournament/dissonance `all_on`, shard `gems_only`), and POST /api/profile-patch {name, path:[policies, gather, <new name>], value, expected_revision} creates it (a missing mapping step is created, so an empty gather map or no gather key both work). A name already taken is REPLACED, not refused: the page must not offer a taken name. The empty policy is refused (gem_delay_sec is required); text, an unknown key and a stale revision are refused.
notes.emulator_bluestacks_inventory: GET /api/wizard/emulators over a bluestacks.conf with two instances (one stopped, one running) and POST /api/wizard/bluestacks/prepare for each. Appended as its own family because emulator_inventory (MuMu world) has no BlueStacks row. `running` is an HD-Player.exe with `--instance <key>`; `adb_enabled` is the GLOBAL switch (every instance of one file carries the same value); `display_ok` is the instance own framebuffer at 2560x1080@360. Prepare is refused 409 while ANY HD-Player.exe runs, whichever instance is named (the stopped instance too); with nothing running it writes the ADB switch and the named instance framebuffer, and an instance already prepared answers 200 with nothing changed and no backup.

templates.description: Farm-style runs entered through the Dissonant Run dialog with one workshop tab disabled, for the permanent Dissonant Boost. Its own equipment (cards, modules, guardians, bots, workshop preset), no upgrade shopping, every owned Ultimate Weapon on, and its own perk bans. Optional tournament-style wall rescue with the fleet-mark Nuke.
templates.label: Dissonance
notes: Tier, equipment, the disabled tab and the perk bans are local choices; with no perk bans given the game's ban list is left as it is.
Creation does not start a run or add a schedule.
Boosts are per tier and max out at wave 5000; a run that dies restarts through Home and the same dialog.
requirements: The Dissonant Run dialog images for the chosen workshop tab (Calibrate, step 8: header, BATTLE, close and that tab's label).
A `dissonance` loadout in Configuration naming this run's card, module, guardian, bot and workshop presets.
Perk bans need the Perks screens mapped by Prepare recognition.
